title: Humanities Writing Companion: An Agent Skill for Voice-Preserving Humanities Academic Writing
description: An agent skill in the open Agent Skills (SKILL.md) format for voice-preserving humanities academic writing. Twelve modes cover research-question development, mapping supplied readings, outlining, drafting, paragraph and chapter review, reviewer stress-testing, writing bottlenecks, revision, promise-delivery checks, factual AI-use disclosure, and integration of external review comments. The compact entrypoint loads detailed discipline and workflow references on demand. Revisions respect the author’s requested scope and existing authorization; reviewer objections are withdrawn when decisive evidence defeats them. Configuration is isolated per paper. Source identity, edition and locator accuracy, and support for a claim are assessed separately. Promise-delivery checks distinguish isolated reviewers from existing conversation context. AI-use disclosure records actual history and checks the target venue’s current policy. Five local helper scripts require zsh and Python 3 without third-party Python packages; the citation candidate lookup uses Crossref/OpenAlex over the network and does not verify source text or argumentative support. Bilingual English and Chinese entrypoints, references, and documentation.
